text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I won, Trainer. I believe I gave a 
performance that even I can be truly proud 
of.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was amazing! That's why—
Yeah, that was amazing! So—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ああ、すごかったよ！だから――
うん、すごかったね！だから――
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you were amazing! That's why—
Yeah, it was amazing! Which is why—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid?! What the heck are you 
tryin' to pour down a bone-dry throat?!
choice_data_list: 打ち上げ！おしるこ＆最中パーティーだ！
打ち上げ！おしるこ＆最中パーティーだよ！
choice_data_list_en: After-party time! It's an oshiruko and monaka party!
After-party time! It's an oshiruko and monaka party!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, you can stop playing the fool now. 
The race is already over, after all.
choice_data_list:
I guess you're right, congratulations, 
Luck!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much. Winning really 
does feel great, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: それもそうか、おめでとうラック！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The cheers and applause directed at me. 
Hearing that makes me feel like all the 
days I endured were worth it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what matters is what comes next. 
Today's praise will be forgotten by 
tomorrow anyway.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"A golden brilliance that stays etched in 
memory forever. That's the kind of star 
performer I strive to be."
choice_data_list: Yeah. But let's at least celebrate today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. If possible, I'd be happier 
if we recharged our energy with some 
high-end yakiniku instead of a sweet bean 
soup party.
choice_data_list: そうだね。でも、今日くらいはお祝いしよう
choice_data_list_en: True. But at least for today, let's celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, at this rate, by the time I become a 
star, you're gonna go broke, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a massive flip-flop. Flipped 
around like a propeller, that did.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Was it the yakiniku? Was it the yakiniku 
that went wrong?!
choice_data_list:

before the meat.

much oshiruko are ya gonna push on me?!
